instruction.thesis: The PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW short was predicated on excessive call buying (P/C=0.414). The IBIT P/C ratio has now risen to 0.593, well above the extreme-low threshold, indicating the contrarian setup has normalized. With the signal's own input round-tripped past invalidation, the original thesis no longer holds.
